_readme: PHOTOGRAPHS OF REAL JOBS.
These appear under 'Our customers, our work' next to the testimonials.
HOW TO ADD ONE
1. Put the image file in  assets/images/work/  in the repository.
2. Copy the block in "example" below into the "photos" list.
3. Fill in src, caption, alt, width and height.
4. Set "published" to true.
5. Commit both the image and this file together.
BEFORE THE PHOTO GOES UP
- If a customer's face, name, door number or vehicle number is in the
frame, either get their permission or use a different shot.
- The inside of someone's home is their private space. 'We were there
doing the job' is not the same as 'we may publish it'.
SIZE MATTERS MORE THAN YOU THINK
A photo straight off a phone is 3-6 MB and will be the slowest thing on
the page by a wide margin. Resize to about 1200px on the long side and
save as JPEG at around 80% quality before committing it; that is
typically 150-250 KB for the same picture on screen.
FIELDS
src        path from the site root, e.g. '/assets/images/work/move-01.jpg'
caption    the line printed under the photo. Optional.
alt        description for someone who cannot see it. Say what is
happening, not 'packers and movers in Kanpur'. Required in
practice: without it the caption is used, and if there is
no caption either the image is announced as a generic one.
width      the image's real pixel width.
height     the image's real pixel height. Both are needed so the page
reserves the space and does not jump while loading.
published  true to show it.
The "example" block below is ignored by the website.
